settings.title: What we collect
settings.body:
Contact details: your name, address, phone number, email and date of birth.

Health information: prescriptions, medicine history, allergies, and anything you or your prescriber tell us that we need to prepare and supply your medicine safely.

For animal patients: the owner's details and the animal's name, species, weight and prescribing vet.

Prescriber details: the name, practice and registration details of the doctor, vet or other prescriber.

Payment and order details: what you ordered, delivery details and payment status. Card numbers are handled by our payment provider and we don't store them.

Website data: pages visited, device and browser type, and information collected through cookies.

settings.title: How we collect it
settings.body: Mostly from you, through our prescription form, your account, phone calls, email or in store. We also receive information from your prescriber when they send a prescription, and from electronic prescription systems.

settings.title: Why we use it
settings.body:
To check, prepare, label and supply your medicine.

To contact you or your prescriber about your prescription, quote or order.

To meet our legal record-keeping duties as a pharmacy.

To process payments and arrange delivery.

To send you marketing emails, only if you've opted in. You can unsubscribe at any time.

settings.title: Who we share it with
settings.body:
Only as much as needed, and only with:

your prescriber, where we need to clarify or confirm a prescription

delivery and courier services, which receive your name, address and phone number

our payment provider and website platform (Shopify)

government bodies, regulators or others where the law requires or allows it, for example monitored-medicine reporting systems

We never sell your personal information.

settings.title: Information stored overseas
settings.body: Our website runs on Shopify, which may store data on servers outside Australia. We take reasonable steps to make sure these providers protect your information in line with Australian law.

settings.title: How we keep it safe
settings.body: We limit access to staff who need it, use password-protected systems, and store paper records securely. We keep records for as long as pharmacy laws require, then destroy them securely.

settings.title: Accessing or correcting your information
settings.body: You can ask to see the information we hold about you, or ask us to correct it. Contact our Privacy Officer using the details below. We'll respond within 30 days. In a few cases the law allows us to refuse access, and if so we'll explain why.

settings.title: Data breaches
settings.body: If a breach is likely to cause you serious harm, we'll tell you and the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC), as required by the Notifiable Data Breaches scheme.

settings.title: Cookies
settings.body: Our site uses cookies to keep your cart, remember your login and understand how the site is used. You can turn cookies off in your browser, but some parts of the site may stop working.

settings.title: Complaints
settings.body: If you're unhappy with how we've handled your information, contact our Privacy Officer first. If you're not satisfied with our response, you can contact the OAIC at oaic.gov.au or 1300 363 992.

settings.title: Contact our Privacy Officer
settings.body: Privacy Officer, CanMed Compounding Chemist, Ground Floor, 90 King William Street, Adelaide SA 5000.

settings.heading: Privacy Policy
settings.intro: This policy explains how CanMed Compounding Chemist ("we", "us") handles your personal information. We follow the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and the Australian Privacy Principles. Much of what we hold is health information, which the law treats as sensitive, so we take extra care with it.
